article.plain_text:
最近有不少推友因为 “Inauthentic Behavior / 不真实行为” 被暂停或封禁。msk又升级了X的防护机制，现在触发短时大量涨fo，大量发帖，IP短时内大量变动和其他因素就可能导致封号。不过，还是有一定几率可以把号救回来，而且用不了多久，有能力一定去试一试。
申诉用英文比较好，可以用中文写后丢给AI翻译，或者用我下面给的模板修改。不要直接照抄，不然同一个模板被抄多次会被判定为批量申诉导致失败。让AI重写一遍就可以了。
不管怎么样，都最好提到自己没有违反X规定。
I am appealing the suspension of my account @USERNAME for alleged inauthentic behavior. I have reviewed X's current Authenticity Policy, including its provisions regarding unauthorized automation, engagement manipulation, coordinated account activity, spam, deceptive identities, and ban evasion. I do not believe my account engaged in these behaviors. I therefore respectfully request a fresh manual review of the underlying activity rather than a reiteration of the original enforcement decision.
其次要搞清楚自己为什么被封，我在这里分成两类处理。
一，大量涨fo / 被转帖互动
如果是确实有大量机器人账号转帖，点赞，关注你，那解封概率会大大降低。这种情况只能在发现的第一时间锁推处理，一般过一天也就好了。
但不管你是不是，都可以用以下模板尝试。
My account recently experienced a significant increase in followers. This growth was organic and resulted from increased visibility and engagement with my posts. I did not purchase followers, use follow-exchange services, automate follows, or use coordinated accounts to artificially increase my follower count. If the rapid increase in followers was treated as an abnormal signal, I respectfully request that X review whether the growth resulted from genuine user activity rather than platform manipulation.
可以在以上模板中再提到最近涨fo原因，比如什么帖子火了之类的。
二，大量发帖
说自己在关注某一事件，连续回复其他用户，发大量原创短帖。
I have been very active on X recently and may have posted or replied at a high frequency. However, these posts were manually written and submitted by me as a genuine user. I did not use bots, scripts, scheduling automation, mass-posting tools, or other software to generate or publish large numbers of posts. A high posting frequency alone should not be interpreted as automated or inauthentic activity, and I respectfully request a manual review of the actual content and posting behavior associated with my account.
三，IP不稳定
一般不是以上问题就是这一种情况了。一般都是机场的锅，注意代理节点一定要固定，频繁跳动非常容易触发风控，可以检查是否开启智能选择节点，如果有就关掉。并且上IP评分网站查询节点分数，尽量选择评分高，没有欺诈行为的节点，以免未来出问题。
这种情况的申诉也比较简单，在申诉中可以直接提到自己使用代理或VPN。一定要提到自己没有违反X用户协议，最好可以引用法律支持。
I regularly access X through a VPN/proxy for connectivity and privacy purposes. If changes in my IP address or apparent location contributed to this enforcement decision, I respectfully request a manual review of my actual account activity. My VPN/proxy does not automate any activity on X and is not used for engagement manipulation, coordinated account activity, ban evasion, or deceptive behavior.
如果你是蓝V
如果你是 X Premium / Premium+ 付费用户，X 当前针对 EU / EFTA / UK 以外地区的 Purchaser Terms 选择 Texas law 作为付费服务争议的适用法律。具体的，
I am a paying X Premium subscriber. Because this enforcement action prevents me from accessing a Paid Service, I respectfully request a good-faith manual review of the factual basis for the suspension. Where applicable, I reserve my rights under relevant consumer-protection law, including the Texas Deceptive Trade Practices-Consumer Protection Act, Tex. Bus. & Com. Code §§ 17.46 and 17.50.
这能很大程度增加解封几率。
最后防封小妙招
避免使用自动化脚本，插件
用稳定的机场环境
被大量机器人关注互动，及时锁推
设置戏仿账号似乎有某种神秘力量不容易被封，可以试一试
可以配置自动化账号设置
不要一次性大量发帖，用定时推文隔一段时间发
希望以上内容能帮助到你解除封号。
